messages:
incidentbot: SEV2 alert created for MonarchBank — dedicated pool eu-west-2-3. Symptom: tenant prefix KV hit-rate collapsed; downstream latencies spiked. Pager sent to @ada (oncall) at 03:14UTC.
ada (oncall): acked. pulling logs now. any impact visible on console? :eyes:
ryan: I see a hit-rate drop on the MonarchBank tenant from ~98% to 6% starting 03:10 UTC. Cache eviction rates skyrocketed. Token cost up ~5x for that tenant.
sophie: confirmed in tracing — many requests bypassing the KV layer and hitting cold model paths. RTT up 400ms median for affected routes.
miguel: sending quick KV metrics:
```
kv_prefix_hitrate{tenant="monarchbank"} 0.06
kv_evictions_per_min{tenant="monarchbank"} 1243
kv_prefetch_queue_len{tenant="monarchbank"} 870
```
ryan: looks like prefix-prefetcher for that tenant got a noisy sweep — prefetch created a ton of unique prefixes and polluted the shard. likely bloom/adapter mis-calculation.
ada (oncall): is this isolated to MonarchBank or is pool-wide?
miguel: isolation check: other tenants on the same dedicated pool show stable hit-rates (90%+). root cause seems tenant-scoped but it has driven evictions on shared shard and triggered write amplification.
eng-sre-lead: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable prefix-prefetch for MonarchBank (fast) 2) evict prefetched namespace proactively 3) move MonarchBank to reserve LRU shard (more involved). Recommend 1+2 now.
sophie: agree. disabling prefetch can be done via feature flag per-tenant. I can roll that in 2 min.
ryan: I'll prepare a safe eviction command. recommend scoped eviction to prefix namespace `mbank:/prefetch/*` so we don't thrash other tenants.
ad a (oncall): typo: "ada (oncall)" — executing?
sophie: rolling flag:
```
POST /admin/tenants/monarchbank/flags
{
  "prefetch_enabled": false
}
```
sophie: flag applied. metrics showing prefetch queue length dropping.
miguel: running scoped eviction now:
```
# run on region shard leader
kv-ctl evict --tenant monarchbank --prefix "mbank:/prefetch/" --batch-size 1000
```
miguel: evict started, progress 0% -> 40% -> 95% in ~90s. eviction reduced evictions_per_min by ~85%.
ryan: small extra safety: add request header override to bypass cache for critical auth routes until hit-rate recovers: ops will add header X-Cache-Bypass: temporary-burst for MonarchBank app mapping.
ad a (oncall): notifying MonarchBank SRE: 
"we are mitigating a KV prefix prefetch storm affecting your tenant. measures: prefetch disabled, targeted eviction, temporary cache-bypass for auth routes. No data loss. Working on recovery and followups"
monarchbank-sre: thanks for the quick response. our customers reported increased latency and some timeouts around 03:12 UTC. any ETA on full recovery?
sophie: indicators good — hit-rate back to ~67% and climbing as cache warms. latencies trending down. ETA ~10-15m to return to baseline.
eng-sre-lead: handoff plan: ada will coordinate immediate mitigation until 03:45UTC then hand off to ryan for deeper cleanup and postmortem. create sev2 incident in PagerDuty and set follow-up meeting.
ad a (oncall): handoff to ryan at 03:30UTC. Ryan, you own postmortem and RCA. please capture timeline, prefetched TTLs, and a fix for prefetch bloom sizing.
ryan: acknowledged. initial hypothesis: a large batch job at MonarchBank triggered a wide prefix scan which the prefetcher incorrectly treated as hot, causing over-aggressive prefix materialization. Next actions: collect prefetch logs, check prefetcher bloom parameters, add per-tenant hard caps and backpressure, and write a canary to disable prefetcher automatically if eviction rate > X.
miguel: saved logs and traces to /var/logs/incidents/2244527777/ and uploaded heap/profile snapshots.
sophie: I'll push an alert that thresholds the eviction spike and auto-pauses prefetcher for a tenant when hit-rate < 20% and evictions > 500/min for 2m.
monarchbank-sre: appreciate that. please keep us posted, we'll prepare a customer-facing summary and mitigations on our side.
eng-sre-lead: closing notes for now: severity remains SEV2 until full baseline recovered and scheduled postmortem. action items assigned: ryan (RCA + fix), sophie (alert + auto-pause), miguel (logs + shard sanity check), ada (contact & timeline).
ada (oncall): marking incident as 'mitigated' in channel. will update status when postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
